summary: HiveLog is the simplest way to track your beehives and stay on top of every inspection.
features: Add unlimited hives with custom names, types, colors, and locations
Log inspections with brood pattern, honey stores, pest level, temperament, and queen sighted
Automatic health status (Healthy / Warning / Critical) based on your latest inspection
See how many days have passed since the last inspection
Inspection history with full notes for every hive
Supports Langstroth, Top-Bar, Warré, Flow Hive, and other hive types
Fully offline — all data stored locally on your device
